verdict.rationale: The API is served under a versioned base path (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`, also served at `/v1/messages`). Models carry versioned names such as `morph-v3-fast`. That is only glancing evidence of API versioning, and nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or changelog. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset guarantees, changelog or migration notes between API versions, published API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), independent corroboration.
